title: Library Fine
description: Write `fine(due, returned)` where both dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` text. The fine is 2 rupees per day late; returning on or before the due date costs nothing.
starter_code:
from datetime import datetime

def fine(due, returned):
    # Write your code here
    pass
solution_code:
from datetime import datetime

def fine(due, returned):
    late = (datetime.strptime(returned, '%Y-%m-%d') - datetime.strptime(due, '%Y-%m-%d')).days
    return max(0, late) * 2
